limits: Offline planner: no model latency or cost is included; live planning adds a model call per question (about 4,670 input / 160 output tokens measured in earlier live runs).
One development machine running client, server and PostgreSQL together; the deployed single-host topology and a managed database were not measured.
Per-user quotas were lifted for the run; with them on, each virtual user would be limited to 20 requests a minute.
Closed-loop clients with no think time: a stress profile, not a model of real user pacing.
Results vary between runs at saturation; the other load records in evidence/runs are earlier runs on a table whose order had been scrambled.
